d: the japanese release of La Blue Girl ZERO volume 1, prequel to the La Blue Girl manga. It was released in english as just volume 1 of La Blue Girl (and the original volumes 1-4 became 3-6) and was also adapted into volume 1 of the La Blue Girl OVA (though with plenty of liberties taken). This is already available on here in english with decensoring, but i couldn't find the raws on any site so i figured i'd upload them myself.
